Name: Jinu in the Casino - talkohlooeys style
Author: zylistic
AuthorLabel: Dolphin Is Not a Fish - zylistic
Description:
[size=2]Wanna use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35359]Jinu in the Casino[/url] but you're using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30727]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' portraits[/url]? I got you.

[/size][size=3][b][u]INSTALLATION:[/u][/b][/size][list=1]
[*][size=2]Install the required mods ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35359]Jinu in the Casino[/url]﻿).[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract the folder into your Mods folder and install like usual.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=2]And done! You now have a soul-sucking 400-year old demon man in a talkohlooeys' style!

To uninstall, just delete the mod from your Mods folder.

Special thanks to:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotAFish[/url] for letting me make this mod and also helping me with a small bit of the code! [/size][size=1][s]I really do learn as I go with these things huh.[/s][/size]
